title: Do not mix synthetic logic lenses: the compass rows are individual/relational/systemic; the three axes are its diagonals (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: 1. We should b careful of mixing synthetic logic lenses.  The compass is made up of a 3x4 matrix... But the 3 in the compass are individual/relational/systemic.  The three axes are actually cardinal, fixed, mutable... These are actually the diagonals of the compass

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-28, correcting the agent's claim that the fractal domain Semantic records has three axes taken from the SRS compass (finding b326b3fb, remedy 19a2db61); recorded verbatim.
